name: dropify-mcp
description: Your source for automatically updated data on 500k+ merch products, via API or MCP.
long_description: Dropify tracks official artist and brand merch stores. Stores span the US, UK, EU, Canada, Australia, Japan and Korea. The API and MCP server read 500k+ products. Each has price, currency, stock, image and store link. Each product's detail adds stock by size. A change feed lists restocks, new drops, price changes and sell-outs. It's read-only. Tokens come with All Access.
